candidates.title: Kenya: At least 24 dead in bus-truck collision on Nairobi-Mombasa highway
candidates.excerpt: At least 24 people were killed and 24 others injured when a bus collided with a truck on Kenya's main Nairobi-Mombasa highway on Sunday. The victims were returning from a church pastor's funeral when the crash occurred.

candidates.title: KTR targets Rahul Gandhi over silence on Telangana corruption
candidates.excerpt: BRS working president KT Rama Rao launched a sharp attack on Congress leader Rahul Gandhi and the Telangana government, alleging corruption, unfulfilled poll promises and misgovernance. Addressing party workers after a minority leader joined the BRS, he claimed Telangana had become an "ATM" for the Congress leadership.
